## What problem does this solve?

Describe the problem or limitation you're running into.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Does this touch the non-negotiable safety requirements?

Check `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s safety-requirements list (ride-safe failure,
immobilizer state machine, layered unlock, brake-light priority, starter
protection, battery protection). If your proposal would change behavior in
one of these areas, explain how it stays compliant — proposals that weaken
them will be declined regardless of the feature's merit otherwise.

## Does this require cloud services, telemetry, or accounts?

MOTO-CTRL is offline-first with zero cloud dependency, permanently — see
`CONTRIBUTING.md`. If your proposal seems to need any of that, describe how
it could work fully offline instead.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you thought about.

## Additional context

Anything else — mockups, links, related issues.
